original_question: Conjecture: For n ⩾ 3, there are no finite simple characteristic quotients of the free group Fn. This is not true for n = 2(W. Y. Chen, A. Lubotzky, P. H. Tiep, to appear in Comment. Math. Helvetici, 2025).

refined_question: Conjecture (Lubotzky, Problem 21.82). For every integer n >= 3, let F_n be the free group of rank n. Is it true that there is no characteristic subgroup K of F_n for which the quotient F_n/K is a finite simple group? ([alglog.org](https://alglog.org/21tkt.pdf?utm_source=openai))
